title.narrative: UNICEF Nepal elevated children's voices and influenced national decisions. Children's priorities shaped Nepal's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) 3.0, one of the world's most child-friendly climate plans, while National Committees committed US$1.4 million in funding, and joint campaigns reached 20 million people via social media, amplifying the impact for children nationwide.
